verdict.rationale: Gitleaks is a CLI that runs fully headlessly (git/dir/stdin commands, exits with non-zero code on findings for CI gating), verified hands-on via probe, and ships a dedicated GitHub Action (gitleaks-action) for automated CI/PR scanning. It's a single static offline binary with no interactive/server requirement, well-suited to automation pipelines. Missing for 10: first-party CI examples beyond GitHub Actions (e.g., GitLab/Jenkins recipes) and no official machine-readable API/llms.txt for agent discovery.
